skill.displayName: Content Rewriter 内容多平台改写
skill.summary: Cross-platform content repurposer. Takes one piece of content and rewrites it for multiple Chinese social media platforms, adapting tone, format, length, and...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Content Rewriter — effortlessly adapt content for top Chinese social platforms.

- Converts a single content piece for Xiaohongshu, Zhihu, WeChat Official Account, and Douyin, with native tone and formatting.
- Adapts text length, style, emoji use, hashtags, and structure per platform requirements.
- Automatically follows platform-specific guidelines for titles, hooks, CTAs, and word count.
- Outputs ready-to-publish versions for each platform, clearly labeled and independently optimized.
